why_trail.why: No docs/architecture/ exists on current main (verified: no architecture dir, no packets/, no MAP_BUILD.md, no index/overlays anywhere in-tree). Repo has never been self-mapped; issue #156 tracks the initial build and records epic-138's ruling that a partial map seeded from one epic's diff is worse than none. So the 'current map' baseline is empty and this reconcile is honest-null by construction. No project deltas (docs/agents/*) exist either.

No packets exist to reconcile: docs/architecture/ is absent, so the set of touched node packets is empty. Epic-198's net change (31 files, scripts/checklist_engine.py, gauge_reader.py, agent_work_root.py, run_skill_eval.py, hooks/spine_rail.py, init_work_area.py, new stage_feedback.py, curate_corpus.py + doctrine/docs) would map to scripts/ role components under a real map, but none exist yet. Per epic-138 ruling (recorded in #156), authoring packets for only these touched nodes would be a rejected partial map. Structural notes are folded into #156 instead. Vacuously satisfied.

No index or overlays exist and none are authored: an honest-null reconcile creates no map artifacts. docs/architecture/{index.md,overlays/,generated/} all absent. Consistent-with-packets is vacuously true because there are zero packets. Building index/overlays now would seed the rejected partial map.

Map is trivially compliant: no docs/architecture/ exists, so no duplicate IDs / missing parents / stale nodes / disallowed kinds possible. The one open structural question (where epic-198's touched components and the new stage_feedback.py struct belong) is routed to #156 as seed material via tc1, not resolved into a partial map. Honest-null reconcile complete; deliverable at CARTOGRAPHER_RECONCILE.md.
